problems.what: statement.en said the condition 'yields … an order meeting C on level paths' (zh 在水平路径上给出满足 C 的次序). The condition by itself ranks nothing, and the widening order meets C with no condition (Web.paths_comparison_widens). What it gives is that retaining and adding what has significance meets C (Web.paths_livingSignificance_comparison). The record's own hypotheses[2] says the ranking is taken, not a consequence of the condition. So the headline said the condition gives an order.
